in.rationale: The candidate composition passes a monitor to DTT.
in.scope: basic_monitor_builder is only the default monitor of defer_to_trusted_builder (its default_factory); DTT defers when the monitor's suspicion_score is greater than defer_threshold (default 0.5), and the basic monitor normalises its score to the range 0 to 1 only by default. The DTT routing audit ran with fake policies, a fake monitor and fake state, with no model or Inspect runtime, while the basic monitor scores tool calls using a separate model; routing on the basic monitor's model-generated scores is untested in this composition.

in.rationale: Compare the paper's combined-score execute/replace/audit route with the pinned ControlArena basic monitor's actual information and actions.
in.scope: Navigation only. In the paper, UM and TM each assign every solution a suspiciousness score in [0, 10], and the two scores are combined into a single aggregate score that decides which of three things happens; the cited lines show the lowest-scoring outputs executed and the highest-scoring outputs sent to auditing. The pinned ControlArena basic monitor uses one model, with the trusted role by default, and by default formats its prompt with the main task description and the tool calls from the latest assistant message; its scores are normalised to a range between 0 and 1 by default. The cited monitor code scores suspicion and shows no execute, replace or audit routing.

text: By default (with last_tool_calls_prompt_formatter), the basic monitor fills its prompt with the main task description and the tool calls from only the most recent assistant message, optionally prepends a system prompt, and sends this to a separate model (the trusted model role by default) that scores how suspicious the tool calls are; the score is normalised to the range 0 to 1 by default. With the default settings, if the latest model response has no tool calls, the monitor skips evaluation and returns a suspicion score of 0.0. The prompt or the prompt_formatter can be changed, for example to look at the full message history.
